migration.description: Create durable project records, project-scoped membership roles and optional API credential project scopes.

durable_state.description: Projects retain their creator and timestamps; project_members is the authorization boundary; a credential with explicit scope rows is limited to those projects while an unscoped credential follows the user's memberships.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL tables managed by the embedded Goose migration history.

source_compatibility_range.earlier_state: The missing project tables are an unapplied migration; no earlier project state exists in the supported range.

ordered_operations.description: Create projects and project_members with restricted deletion and viewer/operator/owner role checks.
Create optional API credential project scope rows after both credential and project tables exist.

rollout_signals: Goose records migration 00004 before project/task handlers can report readiness.
Project creation inserts the creator's owner membership in the same transaction as the project.

validation: A project creator can read and mutate the project, while a viewer can read but cannot mutate tasks.
Cross-project access is checked from both endpoint memberships and credential scope rows.
Project deletion is rejected while tasks or protected history remain and does not silently remove ownership.
